# Purpose

Used for the manual shake wash steps that mechanically dislodge residual intraepithelial lymphocytes (IELs) from intestinal tissue after DTT/EDTA stripping.

# Working buffer composition

**25 mL per mouse** (2 x 10 mL for shake rounds + ~5 mL margin).

EDTA stock: 500 mM. For 2 mM final in 25 mL: add **100 uL** EDTA stock.

| Component | Final concentration | Volume for 25 mL |
|---|---|---|
| RPMI 1640 | Base | 23.6 mL |
| L-glutamine (200 mM stock) | 1% (v/v) | 250 uL |
| Penicillin/Streptomycin (100x stock) | 1% (v/v) | 250 uL |
| HEPES (1 M stock) | 2% (v/v) | 500 uL |
| EDTA (500 mM stock) | 2 mM | 100 uL |

# Preparation

## A. Preparation of stock (if applicable)

Not applicable — prepared directly as the working buffer.

## B. Preparation of working buffer

1. Combine RPMI 1640 with L-glutamine, Penicillin/Streptomycin, HEPES, and EDTA per the table above.
2. Mix gently by inversion.

# Storage and stability

- Can be prepared the evening before use and held at **4 °C**.
